Invite users to a Byzantine account, with the authorization issued by `get-invite-users-payload`.

A Turnkey account sends the stamped `bodyToSign` (`signedBody` + `webAuthnStamp`), from a root user: the users
are created in the Turnkey sub-organization with the `view` role, with a pending invitation to sign up (and to do
a KYC on Byzantine if they did not yet). A self-custodial account sends the same users and chain as the payload

the users join the account right away with the `self_custodial` role, without Turnkey user.

No email is sent: each invitation emits the `account.member_invited` webhook event, on which the integrator
notifies the invitee.

post.description:
Invites again a user who rejected their invitation, let it expire, or has not answered yet. No passkey stamp is
needed: the user created in the Turnkey sub-organization by the first `invite-users` is reused. A new `pending`
invitation is created with a new 7-day window, on behalf of the same inviter; a still `pending` invitation is set
to `cancelled`.

No email is sent: the new invitation emits the `account.member_invited` webhook event, on which the integrator
notifies the invitee again.

Answers 409 when the user already accepted an invitation to the account, when the invitation is not their latest
one, when the original inviter is not a root user of the account anymore, or when the user was removed from the
account (`cancelled`): the latter goes through `invite-users` again.

Unlike `invite-users`, this call is not approved by a root passkey: the integrator decides who may trigger it.

get.description:
Returns the 12h, 24h, 3d, 7d and 31d trailing APYs of an active top vault over time, sampled
from hourly indexer snapshots. Public endpoint: no integrator authentication.

Date bounds filter snapshots inclusively at whole-second precision. The span from the first
to the last matching snapshot is divided into equal-width buckets of at least one hour;
only the latest snapshot in each nonempty bucket is returned. Buckets are not aligned to
calendar hours or days. At most `points` results are returned, with original timestamps:
no interpolation or gap filling. The newest matching snapshot is always included.

For example, a January-to-December request for a vault with data only from October samples
the available October-to-December span, without reserving empty buckets for earlier months.
If metadata resolves successfully but no snapshots match, `data` is empty.

parameters.description:
Inclusive lower bound on snapshot time (RFC 3339), evaluated at whole Unix-second
precision. Dates before the Unix epoch are rejected. Omit to include the earliest data.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description:

precision. Omit to include the latest data. Must not precede `start_date`.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description:
Maximum result count (1 to 365, default 100), not a guaranteed count or frequency.
Buckets span the first to last available snapshot within the date bounds, have equal
widths of at least one hour, and retain their latest snapshot. Empty buckets are omitted.
With points=1, only the latest snapshot in range is returned.

it does not change which snapshots are sampled.

ApyHistoryPoint.description:
Trailing APYs of a top vault at one hourly indexer snapshot.

Same semantics as `ApyResponse`: ratios (`0.05` == 5%), computed by the indexer at snapshot
time, not averaged over sampling buckets or recalculated as returns between the selected
points.

chain_id.description: Chain of the vault. Required only when the address is a top vault on several chains.

start_date.description:
Inclusive lower bound on snapshot time (RFC 3339), evaluated at whole Unix-second
precision. Dates before the Unix epoch are rejected. Omit to include the earliest data.

end_date.description:
Inclusive upper bound on snapshot time (RFC 3339), evaluated at whole Unix-second
precision. Omit to include the latest data. Must not precede `start_date`.

points.description:
Maximum result count (1 to 365, default 100), not a guaranteed count or frequency.
Buckets span the first to last available snapshot within the date bounds, have equal
widths of at least one hour, and retain their latest snapshot. Empty buckets are omitted.
With points=1, only the latest snapshot in range is returned.

order.description:
Order by snapshot time: `asc` (default) or `desc`. Reverses the same selected points;
it does not change which snapshots are sampled.

ApyResponse.description:
Trailing APYs of a top vault from its latest hourly indexer snapshot.

Each APY is the compounded annualization of the price-per-share change over the trailing
window, as a ratio (`0.05` == 5%). The indexer accepts values in `[0, 2]`; outside that
range it reuses the previous valid APY for the same window, or zero if unavailable.
A fresh snapshot can therefore retain a positive APY after a price decline.
A vault younger than a window uses its oldest snapshot as the calculation boundary.

timestamp.description: Block time of the snapshot the APYs were computed at

configured by the integrator's frontend.

successUrl.description: HTTPS page the customer is sent to after submitting the verification. `link` only.

rejectUrl.description: HTTPS page the customer is sent to when the verification is refused. `link` only.

InitVerificationResponse.description:
Response body of `init-verification`. Exactly one of `verificationUrl` and `accessToken` is set,
according to `mode`. Neither is stored by Byzantine: call the endpoint again for a new one.

verificationUrl.description: Hosted Web SDK page, `link` mode only.

expiresAt.description: When the link or token stops opening a session. A session already open is not interrupted.

InvitationSummary.description: `data.invitation` of the invitation events. No status field: the event type carries it 1:1.

expiresAt.description:
End of the acceptance window, for an invitation that is `pending` or `expired` when the event is emitted
(`member_invited` of an invitation not created accepted, `invitation_expired`); `null` otherwise. Always
emitted, like every key of a signed webhook.

InvitationWithUserDetails.description: Invitation with user details (email and name)

oneOf.description: Turnkey account: the `bodyToSign` returned by `get-invite-users-payload`, stamped with a root user's passkey

webAuthnStamp.description: Cryptographically passkey signed (stamped). For more info, see [authentication methods](https://docs.byzantine.fi/api-reference/authentication-methods).

oneOf.description: Self-custodial account: the users sent to `get-invite-users-payload`, and the wallet signature of its `typedData`

walletSignature.description: Hex-encoded signature of the `typedData` by the account wallet (`eth_signTypedData_v4`).

InviteUsersAuthorization.description: The authorization of a users invitation, matching the account kind

InviteUsersRequest.description: Request body for inviting a user to a Byzantine account

InviteUsersRequestBody.description: Request body of `invite-users`: the inviter, and the authorization issued by `get-invite-users-payload`

typedData.description: Self-custodial accounts: the EIP-712 typed data to sign with the account wallet (`eth_signTypedData_v4`).

issuedAt.description: Self-custodial accounts: the `issuedAt` of the typed data (unix seconds), to send back with the wallet signature.

InviteUsersResponse.description: Response body when new users are successfully invited to a Byzantine account

invitedAt.description: The timestamp when the users were invited.

InvitedUser.description: The details of the new users invited.

firstName.description: The first name of the new user.

lastName.description: The last name of the new user.

userEmail.description: The email of the new user.

ethereum.description: Atlas delegation active on Ethereum Mainnet (`chain_id` 1)

label.description: The label the customer gave this bank account at `add-bank-account`.

bankName.description:
Name of the bank holding the account, as declared at `add-bank-account` (`null` when the IBAN
payload did not declare it, or for bank accounts added before it was recorded).

last4.description:
Last four characters of the account number (IBAN or ACH) declared at `add-bank-account`
(`null` for bank accounts added before it was recorded). The full number is never stored.

credentials.description: Credentials owned by the authenticated integrator, oldest first.

eventType.description: Filter by a lifecycle event type. `webhook.test` is not a lifecycle event.

createdAfter.description: Exclusive lower bound on database creation time.

createdBefore.description: Exclusive upper bound on database creation time.

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor. Keep filters unchanged while paging.

limit.description: Page size from 1 to 250. Defaults to 100.

ListEventsResponse.description: One page of events with an opaque cursor for the next page, if any.

ListWebhookDeliveriesQuery.description: Delivery history filters accept documented camelCase query names plus `snake_case` aliases for operator ergonomics.

limit.description: Page size for delivery history. Defaults to 100 and is capped at 250.

offset.description: Number of delivery records to skip. Defaults to 0.

includeAttempts.description: Include delivery attempt records for each delivery. Defaults to true for backwards compatibility; set false for lighter list views.

eventType.description: Restrict to one public event type, e.g. `customer.active` or `webhook.test`.

sourceType.description: Restrict to source type. Known values include `bridge`, `sumsub`, and `customer_api`; future sources are exact-match strings.

sourceId.description: Restrict to the durable event source id.

MoneyServices.description:
Financial services a business offers. Its presence is the declaration that the business
conducts money services; every field inside is then required.

description.example: Digital asset custody for institutional clients

conductedThroughAccount.description:
Will those services be conducted through the Byzantine account? When true, a
`flow_of_funds` document is required.

complianceScreeningExplanation.description: The compliance and anti-money-laundering controls in place for those services.
complianceScreeningExplanation.example: KYC on every client, transaction monitoring and sanctions screening

NaiveDateTime.description: A naive datetime string without timezone

NewUser.description: The details of the new user to invite.

firstName.description: The first name of the user to invite.

lastName.description: The last name of the user to invite.

userEmail.description: The email of the user to invite.

OtpAuthRequestBody.description: Request to authenticate with OTP code

otpId.description: The OTP ID returned by init-otp

otpCode.description: The OTP code received by email

associatedPerson.description: Associated person the requirement is scoped to, when applicable.

PendingInvitation.description: Response body for a pending invitation

PublicListing.description: A public listing of the business.

marketIdentifierCode.description: ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code of the venue.

RegulatedActivity.description: Regulatory licence of a business conducting regulated activities.

RejectInvitationRequest.description: Request to reject an invitation on behalf of the invitee

RemovalOutcome.description: What a removal did to the user's membership

userIds.description: The IDs of the users to remove. A `root` user cannot be removed: demote them first.

oneOf.description: Turnkey account: the `bodyToSign` returned by `get-remove-users-payload`, stamped with a root user's passkey

webAuthnStamp.description: Cryptographically passkey signed (stamped). For more info, see [authentication methods](https://docs.byzantine.fi/api-reference/authentication-methods).

Request body of `remove-users`: the authorization issued by `get-remove-users-payload`, matching the account kind.

No `removedBy` is sent: a Turnkey account's remover is the root user whose passkey produced the stamp, and a
self-custodial account acts through its wallet.

issuedAt.description: Self-custodial accounts: the `issuedAt` of the typed data (unix seconds), to send back with the wallet signature.

RemovedUser.description: One removed user and what happened to their membership

RPC's `eth_getTransactionReceipt` to get the full receipt.

bankAddress.description: The address of the beneficiary bank.

bankBeneficiaryName.description: The name of the beneficiary. Either first and last name, or a business name.

bankBeneficiaryAddress.description: The address of the beneficiary. Not returned by Bridge for all rails (e.g. omitted on SEPA virtual accounts).

bankAccountNumber.description: In case of a USD deposit, the bank account number to deposit to.

bankRoutingNumber.description: In case of a USD deposit, the ban routing number to deposit to.

iban.description: In case of a EUR deposit, the IBAN to deposit to.

bic.description: In case of a EUR deposit, the BIC to deposit to.

positions.description: List of sub-account's active positions (balances across vaults)

TeamMember.description: Response body for a team member

TransactionEventData.description:
`data` of every `transaction.*` event: the transaction after the transition, and the observable
status it comes from.

`previousStatus` is `null` on the first event of a transaction and on any
transition out of an internal status (`created` / `claimed`), which are never emitted.

TransactionStatusView.description: The current status of the transaction, as returned by the API.

TransactionSummary.description:
`data.transaction`: the public transaction resource, exactly as `GET /v1/query/get-transactions`
shapes it minus the nested `account` duplicate (`accountId` stays).

Deliberately not
`TransactionView`: its optional fields are skipped when empty, whereas a signed webhook must
emit every key (`null` when empty) for strict schema validators.

TransactionType.description: Type of transaction stored in the database.

TransactionTypeView.description: Type of transaction returned by the API.

UpdateAssociatedPersonRequest.description: Request body for updating an associated person's details.

UpdateAssociatedPersonResponse.description: Response body for updating an associated person

missingDocuments.description: List of missing required verification documents. Present only if not all required documents have been submitted.

label.description: The new label, returned as `label` wherever the bank account appears.

UpdateBeneficiaryDetails.description: Beneficiary details update payload. All fields are optional — only provided fields are updated.

title.description: Required for representatives. The title held at the business.

ownershipPercentage.description: Required for UBOs. The % of direct or indirect business ownership.

isSigner.description: Can this person authorise transactions on behalf of the business?

active.description: New active status for the credential. Left untouched when omitted.

label.description: New label for the credential. Left untouched when omitted.

UpdateEntityAccountRequest.description:
Request body for updating an entity account's company details.
Only the provided fields will be updated. To add or update entity's associated persons, see the dedicated associated-persons endpoints.

entityDocuments.description:
Additional entity verification documents, typically the ones listed in `missingDocuments` of a
previous response. See [accepted documents](https://docs.byzantine.fi/api-reference/documents).

UpdateEntityAccountResponse.description: Response body for updating an entity account

missingDocuments.description:
List of missing required entity verification documents. Present only if not all required documents have been submitted.
Values: `COMPANY_DETAILS_DOCUMENT`, `OWNERSHIP_STRUCTURE_DOCUMENT`, `SOURCE_OF_FUNDS_DOCUMENT`,
`PROOF_OF_ADDRESS_DOCUMENT`, `PHYSICAL_ADDRESS_QUESTIONNAIRE`, `ACTIVITY_INFO_QUESTIONNAIRE`,

missingCompanyData.description: List of missing required company data. Present only if not all required company information has been provided.

UpdateEntityInfo.description: Entity information for update. All fields are optional — only provided fields are updated.

businessLegalName.description: The legal name of the business.

businessTradeName.description: The trade name of the business. Can be the same as the entity name.

companyNumber.description: The registered business number. Depending on the country of registration, we accept these [entity number types](https://docs.byzantine.fi/api-reference/lists/company-number-types).

phone.description: Business phone number with country code (E.164).

fiatCurrencies.description: Fiat rails the customer will use (USD → `base`, EUR → `sepa`).

otherWebsites.description: Other websites and social media handles of the business.

Request body for updating an individual account's user details.

fiatCurrencies.description: Fiat rails the customer will use (USD → `base`, EUR → `sepa`).

UpdateIndividualAccountResponse.description: Response body for updating an individual account

missingDocuments.description: List of missing required verification steps. Present only if not all required documents have been submitted.

Personal information about the user for update. All fields are optional — only provided fields are updated.
Same as `UserInfo` but without `email` (email cannot be changed).

nationalities.description: Every nationality held by the user. Required by Bridge for EEA residents.

cityOfBirth.description: User's city of birth. Recommended for EEA residents, required by EU law from 2027.

socialSecurityNumber.description: Required exclusively for USA-based users. Must be the full social security number.

profilePictureUrl.description: URL of the user's profile picture (can be an avatar)

userIds.description: The unique identifiers of users beeing promoted / demoted.

webAuthnStamp.description: Cryptographically passkey signed (stamped). For more info, see [authentication methods](https://docs.byzantine.fi/api-reference/authentication-methods).

UpdateUsersRoleResponse.description: Response body when users' roles are successfully updated

threshold.description: The new threshold of unique approvals to reach quorum.

rootUserIds.description: The unique identifiers of users who now comprise the quorum set.

httpHeaders.description:
Per-header patch merged into the current custom headers: a string sets or replaces that
header, null deletes it, and an absent name keeps its value. Omit, null or {} to leave
all headers unchanged. Every name in the patch must be a valid, non-reserved HTTP header
name; limits (max 16, 8 KiB total) and case-insensitive duplicates are validated on the
merged result.

UserDetailsQuery.description: Query parameters for getting user details

UserDocumentType.description:
Type of the document. See the full list of [accepted documents](https://docs.byzantine.fi/api-reference/documents).

Identity documents: `passport`, `national_id_front` + `national_id_back`,
`drivers_license_front` + `drivers_license_back`, `residence_permit_front` + `residence_permit_back`.
A passport or national ID is preferred: it is accepted in every country Bridge supports.

UserInfo.description: Personal information about the user required for identity verification.

nationalities.description: Every nationality held by the user. Required by Bridge for EEA residents.

cityOfBirth.description: User's city of birth. Recommended for EEA residents, required by EU law from 2027.

socialSecurityNumber.description: Required exclusively for USA-based users. Must be the full social security number.

profilePictureUrl.description: URL of the user's profile picture (can be an avatar)

UserSourceOfFunds.description: Source of funds for users. Required for high risk users.

UserSummary.description:
A member of the account named by an `account.*` event: the affected user (`data.user`), or the
two sides of an invitation (`data.invitation.invitee` / `invitedBy`).

UserSummaryWithRole.description: Minimal user information with the user's role in the account

UserVerificationDocument.description: Document(s) to verify the identity of the user.

documentNumber.description: Required for identity documents (passport, national ID). Must be the full document number.

issueDate.description:
Issue date of the document (`yyyy-mm-dd`). A proof of address must be issued within the
last 90 days.

expirationDate.description:
Expiration date of an identity document (`yyyy-mm-dd`). Expired documents are refused and
Bridge revokes endorsements when the document on file expires.

document.description:
The document to be uploaded.

Supported MIME types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/heic, image/tiff, application/pdf

is_async_vault.description: Whether the vault is an asynchronous vault
